name: Backend Semantic Allow Matrix
description: Semantic, role-based import rules for backend architecture. Enforces decision boundaries and contract purity.
core_principle: A layer may import another layer only if it consumes its responsibility, never its decisions.
invariants: Contracts must be pure and dependency-free
Decision layers must never depend on Aggregation or Execution layers
Execution layers must not influence decision or state composition

notes.contract_layers: CONTRACT layers define semantic interfaces only and must not carry business logic or runtime behavior.
notes.decision_layers: DECISION layers own all business decisions and may only consume contracts or peer decision helpers.
notes.aggregation_layers: AGGREGATION layers only combine or normalize results from executed decisions and must never evaluate rules.
notes.dispatch_layers: DISPATCH layers orchestrate flow across layers but do not own decisions.
notes.execution_layers: EXECUTION layers perform side effects and runtime work without decision authority.
